the development and dissemination of plant protection practices for oilseed crops in India.
the development and dissemination of improved plant protection technologies for enhancing productivity and profitability of oilseed crops under farmers’ conditions.
the development of a novel approach to the development of a new approach to the development and dissemination of plant protection in oil seeds.

, there is need for a concerted effort for dissemination of need based plant protection technologies to oilseed farmers for enhancing productivity and profitability.
the frontline demonstrations on need based crop protection in oilseed crop have shown a positive impact on productivity and profitability.

the frontline demonstrations on need based crop protection in oilseed have been very effective in enhancing productivity and profit of the farmers and thus the technologies have been disseminated to the farmers in the study area.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the need based plant protection technologies in oilseeds are feasible and can be replicated at farmers’ fields with assured benefits.
, the need-based integrated plant protection in oil seeds is technically and economically feasible and can enhance productivity and profitability under the prevailing farmers’ conditions.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the farmers’ fields are ideal places to test and demonstrate the technologies and the extension agencies are the best partners to scale-up the technologies to farmers’ fields.
the adoption of IT by the farmers can be accelerated through the involvement of the state department of agriculture, extension agencies and input agencies.
the adoption of IT by farmers can enhance productivity and profitability and thus, can help in achieving the goal of increasing farmers’ income and ensuring food and nutritional security.
